scheme_name: West Bengal Textile Incentive Scheme: State Capital Investment Subsidy
other_conditions: The unit must have started production on or after 1st April 2022
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or owned/managed by the State Government
The scheme shall not be applicable to industrial units/enterprises
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank, or State Financial Institution
The unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate, and Eligibility Certificate issued by the Directorate of Textiles
benefits_summary: Provides a capital investment subsidy of 10‑20% of project cost, with maximum admissible amounts varying by type of manufacturing activity.
documents_required: Eligibility Certificate issued by the Directorate of Textiles
